label: About
title: About The Kiss Behind the Torn Bill
short_blurb: A daily generated front page where the image is the interface.
body: Daily Frontpage is a daily generated interactive front page. Each edition starts from a saved source, becomes a new image-led scene, and stays explorable in the archive. The image is the interface: a visible mark in the scene opens the real source that shaped the day.

This edition began with one saved post, @m44444nu: Scrolling through @CreamyDreamy and @bis__cut 111K outputs over the past few.... Its image from pbs.twimg.com set the palette, contrast, edge behavior, and gesture. The scene became The Kiss Behind the Torn Bill: Weathered hoarding of torn cinema bills, flat frontal wide plate, horizontal décollage triptych. A ragged vertical tear-aperture right of center reveals warm ochre skin, a thrown-back crimson mouth and clutching hands; a frieze of pale white horse heads crosses a cobalt sky band at top left; illegible red block-lett... After the image was made, a plate-reading pass mapped the source to Ragged tear-aperture exposing crimson mouth, embrace and clutching hands.

typography.rationale: Fraunces and Newsreader fit image-led art objects while Space Grotesk keeps process labels crisp.
